name: sealskin (linuxserver)
description: Sealskin(https://github.com/selkies-project/sealskin/) is a self-hosted browser isolation and remote application streaming platform. It runs desktop applications in isolated containers on a server you control and streams them to any browser or phone. Clients include a browser extension, mobile apps, and a web app served by the server itself. Each turns links, files, downloads, and text selections into something you open remotely instead of locally, so nothing from the web runs on the device in front of you.

paths.description: All file storage for home directories and ephemeral mounts.

ports.description: HTTPS Sessions and API communication port.
HTTP fallback API port, only needed by the Chrome extension with a self-signed certificate.
Peer listener, only needed to join several servers into a cluster.
